messages:
Ivy: quick pass on the dense endpoint list — action buttons are visually compact but the tap targets are tiny on mobile. users reported missed taps during usability. screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/dense-list-tap.png
Noel: saw that. current `compact-btn` uses 6px vertical padding; increase to meet 44px target. propose a utility `hit-target-44` we can apply to icon-only buttons. keeps visuals but expands interactive area.
Harper: +1. also tooltips appear immediately on hover which makes them pop in while users are trying to tap a button. can we increase show delay to 500ms and make them cancel on pointerdown?
Luis: implementation note: I'll add `.hit-target-44 { padding: 10px; margin: -10px; }` as a general pattern. For tooltips we'll set delays `[500, 100]` and add `onTrigger` to ignore during touch gestures.
Ivy: toasts: success toasts for row actions are currently inside the table container and overlap fixed action bar. prefer mounting to `#global-toast-root` with breakpoint rules so they don't occlude controls. ensures they float above everything.
Noel: agree. add `toast.portal = true` and `toast.anchor = 'top-right' | 'bottom-center'` with default rules. also add `avoidSelectors: ['.fixed-action-bar', '.modal']` to handle special cases.
Harper: a11y: toasts must not take focus away from the row or modal. use `aria-live="polite"` and make them non-focusable by default. errors can be `assertive`. also ensure tooltip and aria-labels on icon buttons match exactly.
Luis: copy nit: inline action currently labeled "Run" but triggers a background job. change to "Start job" and toast to "Job started" so language matches the action. small but reduces confusion.
Ivy: motion: respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for toast and tooltip animations. on reduced motion, use instant show/hide. also add a tiny debounce on resize so toast repositioning doesn't thrash on viewport changes.
Noel: i'll draft a short PR: add `hit-target-44` util, update `btn-compact` to include it for icon-only, tooltip delay tweak, and toast portal with avoidSelectors. will include unit tests for widths 360px and 1024px.
AccessibilityBot: checklist: hit-targets - fail (before change), tooltips - warn (delay), toasts - warn (mounting). filing tickets RED-501, RED-502.
Harper: i'll run an a11y sweep once the PR lands and validate NVDA/VoiceOver flows plus keyboard navigation. also please add a short docs note in the List component about using `compact` only when necessary.
Ivy: perfect. let's aim to land this in next sprint so we don't ship more missed taps. thanks team :thumbsup:
